item.title: 7 apartment buildings planned for Harmony Technology Park – BizWest
item.description: Seven three-story buildings holding a total of about 261 market-rate apartments could soon rise as part of the Harmony Technology Park in southeast Fort Collins.

item.title: Firestone’s pro soccer ambitions deflated – BizWest
item.description: Firestone town officials have issued a red card to a proposed stadium at Central Park, ending — for now, at least — a short-lived push to bring professional soccer back to Northern Colorado.

item.title: Raising Cane's opens Loveland location – BizWest
item.description: Baton Rouge, Louisiana-based Raising Cane’s, a 30-year-old chain that specializes in fried chicken fingers and crinkle-cut french fries, opened a Loveland location Monday.

item.title: Westminster to debut restaurant week in April – BizWest
item.description: Westminster’s first restaurant week, dubbed Westy Restaurant Week, will take place April 17-26.

item.title: Clinica Family Health &amp; Wellness reveals 2025 data breach – BizWest
item.description: Clinica Family Health &amp; Wellness recently informed patients that the organization, which merged with Mental Health Partners in 2024, was the target of a March 2025 data breach.

item.title: Laird Superfood losses grew in Q4 after Navitas acquisition – BizWest
item.description: Laird Superfood Inc. posted high sales in the fourth quarter of 2024, but the Boulder-based natural-foods company also grew its losses, in part because of costs associated with its acquisition of Navitas LLC.

item.title: Greeley DDA OKs $1.2M in incentives for boutique hotel – BizWest
item.description: A proposed boutique hotel that would anchor a new civic campus in downtown Greeley secured initial backing Thursday from the Greeley Downtown Development Authority.

item.title: Banks confront surge in AI-driven fraud risks – BizWest
item.description: Scammers, hackers and fraudsters are taking advantage of the newest technological tools to not only scam bank customers but attempt to scam the institutions themselves.

item.title: Coca-Cola bottler breaks ground on new Colorado plant – BizWest
item.description: Swire Coca-Cola, a soda bottler, recent broke ground on a 620,000-square-foot plant in Colorado Springs.

item.title: Fort Collins art museum director to step down – BizWest
item.description: Lisa Hatchadoorian will resign from her role as executive director of the Museum of Art Fort Collins in late July after more than 11 years in the role.

item.title: Auddia plans reverse stock split to stave off Nasdaq delisting – BizWest
item.description: Auddia, a Boulder-based audio-technology company that’s in the process of merger, informed regulators and investors that it plans a reverse stock split.

item.title: Silvis Materials selected for Cox clean-tech accelerator – BizWest
item.description: Silvis Material, a Boulder developer of a bio-based adhesive for packaging and construction, was selected to participate in the Cox Cleantech Accelerato.

item.title: Discount deadline nears for NoCo Real Estate Summit – BizWest
item.description: Eight days remain to get discounted tickets for BizWest’s Northern Colorado Real Estate Summit, featuring a comprehensive analysis of residential and commercial real estate trends, data and key market segments.

item.title: Sierra Space hires aerospace industry vet as new strategy chief – BizWest
item.description: Sierra Space Corp. has hired Jeff Schrader as chief strategy officer.

item.title: University of Colorado-built satellites launched – BizWest
item.description: A pair of small satellites built by a team led by University of Colorado aerospace engineering associate professor Robert Marshall were recently launched into space.
